name: Darkmaster Gandling
summary: Beneath Caer Darrow, Darkmaster Gandling trains necromancers for the Scourge. From Scholomance, he serves the Cult of the Damned through experiments on the living and the dead.

sections.title: The Headmaster's Domain
sections.body: Darkmaster Gandling rules Scholomance beneath Caer Darrow. The academy trains aspiring necromancers for the Scourge. Gandling is a living human of the Cult of the Damned. With the lich Ras Frostwhisper, he committed atrocities against innocent captives taken from the surrounding lands. In the classrooms, students learn to brew plagues, reanimate the dead, and sculpt flesh.

sections.title: Master of the Reliquary
sections.body: In the Headmaster's Study, Gandling commands Scholomance's dark relics and trapped spirits. He joins arcane and shadow magic with forbidden necromancy. With these arts, he curses intruders and hurls them through shadow portals into sealed chambers around the study. There, they face the risen dead alone while Gandling shields himself from harm.

faq.answer: Darkmaster Gandling runs Scholomance, where he trains necromancers to serve the Lich King. He is a human of the Cult of the Damned.

faq.q: Is Gandling an undead or a living human?
faq.answer: Gandling is a living human mortal, though he commands death magic and serves the Scourge. He leads mortal acolytes and cultists within Scholomance.

faq.q: What is his connection to Ras Frostwhisper?
faq.answer: Ras Frostwhisper taught Gandling. The human headmaster and the powerful lich presided over Scholomance's dark instruction and oversaw horrors against innocent souls such as the Sarkhoffs within Caer Darrow.
Gandling resides in the Headmaster's Study at the bottom of Scholomance. The catacombs beneath Caer Darrow in Darrowmere Lake lead to it.

angles.text: As a Mage, you may see Gandling twisting Dalaran's scholarly traditions toward the making of undeath.
As an Undead, you may see Gandling as a hated overseer of Scourge indoctrination. Beneath Caer Darrow, he binds free souls into eternal enslavement.
